result.label: the Pyrelands
result.description: A hot, wind-scoured savanna that burns on a schedule of its own. Coarse fast grass carpets the ground faster than anything can eat it, dries out within days of growing, and goes up at the first dry-storm strike. What is left behind is ash: falling out of the sky for days after a big burn, banking into drifts, and packing down into a grey hardpan that nothing roots through. The rare rain here is black with it. Little grows tall enough to matter, so the horizon is nothing but grass, scars and smoke.
